title: How Much Does the Harness Matter, and for Whom? A Multi-Model Study of Context in LLM-Driven Vulnerability Discovery
title_zh: 测试框架影响几何、对谁影响几何？LLM 驱动漏洞发现中上下文的多模型研究

paragraphs.en: Large language models can now find real security vulnerabilities in production code, and growing evidence suggests that the agent harness (tools, context, bundled infrastructure) substantially affects model capability ( Big Sleep Team, 2024 ; DARPA, 2025 ) . How much this matters, how that varies across models, and which model-and-harness pairings are worth their cost remain unclear, since most studies use few top-tier models on public, already-patched vulnerabilities they may have seen in training ( Wang et al., 2025a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型如今能够在生产代码中发现真实的安全漏洞，且越来越多的证据表明，智能体框架（工具、上下文、配套基础设施）会显著影响模型能力（Big Sleep Team, 2024; DARPA, 2025）。 这一因素影响有多大、在不同模型之间差异如何，以及哪些模型与框架的组合物有所值，仍不清楚，因为大多数研究只使用少数顶级模型，针对的是公开且已修复的漏洞，而这些漏洞可能早已出现在模型的训练数据中（Wang et al., 2025a）。

paragraphs.en: We address this with a multi-model, cost-aware study using an open-source agent harness ( Ubl, 2026 ) . The harness statically screens code and uses an LLM agent to investigate candidates. A review pipeline then applies model self-revalidation, root-cause mapping, independent source review, and an isolated proof-of-concept (PoC) confirmation. We run 24 model–runner configurations on a real production codebase (codename Conduit 1 1 1 A codename; the repository’s identity is withheld for responsible disclosure (Section 15 ). ) whose vulnerabilities were non-public at scan time.

paragraphs.en: We find that no single model–harness configuration covers all the observed findings. Across 265 confirmed security root causes observed, the largest two-run set covers 60.4%, and 14.3% are found by exactly one model, so complete coverage comes from a combination of models. Secondly, the value of structured program context depends on the model: moving from a minimal prompt (A0) to an engineered prompt with a CodeQL-derived call graph raises criticality-weighted yield by 20–86% for smaller and mid-tier models but only 2% for the frontier model, with the same direction of effect appearing on a held-out CyberGym subset. Thirdly, the frontier models achieve low false-report rates but not uniquely higher raw yield: strong lower-cost models can achieve similar performance at an order of magnitude lower cost. Together, these results argue against a one-size-fits-all recipe: the value of the context and tools an agent is given is a property of the model, harness, and task together, and the largest returns come from matching them.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，没有任何单一的模型–执行框架配置能够覆盖所有观察到的发现。 在观察到的 265 个已确认的安全根因中，最大的两次运行组合覆盖了 60.4%，而 14.3% 仅由一个模型发现，因此完整覆盖需要多个模型的组合。 其次，结构化程序上下文的价值取决于模型：从最小提示（A0）切换到包含由 CodeQL 导出的调用图的工程化提示，可使较小和中端模型的临界性加权产出提升 20–86%，而对前沿模型仅提升 2%，且在留出的 CyberGym 子集上出现了相同方向的效果。 第三，前沿模型实现了较低的误报率，但并非唯一拥有更高原始产出的模型：强大的低成本模型能以低一个数量级的成本达到相近的性能。 综上所述，这些结果反对一刀切的方案：智能体所获得的上下文和工具的价值是模型、执行框架与任务三者共同作用的属性，而最大的收益来自三者的相互匹配。

paragraphs.en: Large language models have moved beyond classifying whether a snippet is vulnerable to finding and exploiting real vulnerabilities in production software ( Ding et al., 2025 ; Ahmed et al., 2025 ; Glazunov and Brand, 2024 ; Big Sleep Team, 2024 ; DARPA, 2025 ) : Google’s Project Zero coupled a model with a debugger, code browser, and executor and surfaced a memory-safety flaw in SQLite that extensive fuzzing had missed ( Glazunov and Brand, 2024 ; Big Sleep Team, 2024 ) ; LLM-augmented fuzzing uncovered a decades-old bug in OpenSSL ( Chang et al., 2024 ) ; and the DARPA AI Cyber Challenge fielded autonomous systems that discover, prove, and patch vulnerabilities; under independent scoring, these systems not only found most of the planted challenge bugs but also surfaced 18 real, non-synthetic vulnerabilities in open-source software ( DARPA, 2025 ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Chin et al., 2026 ) . A consistent lesson is that the harness around the model (its tools, context, and iterative loop) contributes as substantially to capability ( Glazunov and Brand, 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Nie et al., 2025 ) ; a promising harness ingredient is structured program context that turns a codebase into a queryable graph of calls, entry points, and data flow ( Arciszewski, 2026 ; Li et al., 2024 ) . Prior NLP work shows that effective retrieval can let smaller models rival much larger ones on some knowledge-intensive tasks ( Borgeaud et al., 2021 ; Izacard et al., 2022 ) , and tool or agent scaffolding can elicit behavior that unaided models lack ( Yao et al., 2022 ; Schick et al., 2023 ) . Whether that holds for vulnerability discovery on real code, for which models, and at what cost, has not, to our knowledge, been widely measured.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型已不再局限于判断代码片段是否存在漏洞，而是能够在生产软件中发现并利用真实漏洞（Ding et al., 2025；Ahmed et al., 2025；Glazunov and Brand, 2024；Big Sleep Team, 2024；DARPA, 2025）：谷歌的 Project Zero 将模型与调试器、代码浏览器和执行器相结合，发现了 SQLite 中一个被大量模糊测试遗漏的内存安全缺陷（Glazunov and Brand, 2024；Big Sleep Team, 2024）；由大语言模型增强的模糊测试发现了 OpenSSL 中一个存在数十年的漏洞（Chang et al., 2024）；DARPA 的 AI 网络挑战赛则部署了能够发现、证明并修补漏洞的自主系统；在独立评分下，这些系统不仅找到了绝大多数植入的挑战性漏洞，还发现了开源软件中 18 个真实的、非人工构造的漏洞（DARPA, 2025；Kim et al., 2025；Chin et al., 2026）。 一个一致的结论是，围绕模型的执行框架（其工具、上下文和迭代循环）对能力有相当大的贡献（Glazunov and Brand, 2024；Liu et al., 2026；Zhu et al., 2026；Nie et al., 2025）；一种有前景的框架要素是结构化程序上下文，它将代码库转化为一个可查询的调用、入口点和数据流图（Arciszewski, 2026；Li et al., 2024）。 先前的自然语言处理研究表明，有效的检索可以让较小的模型在某些知识密集型任务上与规模大得多的模型相媲美（Borgeaud et al., 2021；Izacard et al., 2022），而工具或智能体脚手架可以激发出无辅助模型所不具备的行为（Yao et al., 2022；Schick et al., 2023）。 据我们所知，这一结论是否适用于真实代码上的漏洞发现、适用于哪些模型、以及代价如何，尚未得到广泛测量。

paragraphs.en: There has been considerable discussion about the release of capable offensive-security models, such as Mythos, and the risk of such models identifying exploits in critical open-source software ( LiveOverflow, 2026 ; Carlini, 2026 ; Ziegler, 2026 ) . Here we show that smaller, already-available models, given proper tools and context, can still provide valuable findings in real vulnerability discovery. Source-derived context improves the smaller models in our context experiment while in our testing we also show that low-cost models can contribute findings missed by more expensive configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 关于具备攻击性安全能力的模型（如 Mythos）的发布，以及此类模型在关键开源软件中发现漏洞利用的风险，已有相当多的讨论 ( LiveOverflow, 2026 ; Carlini, 2026 ; Ziegler, 2026 ) 。 我们在这里表明，较小的、已经可获得的模型，在给定合适的工具和上下文的情况下，仍然可以在真实的漏洞发现中提供有价值的发现。 在我们的上下文实验中，源自源代码的上下文提升了较小模型的表现；同时在我们的测试中，我们还表明低成本模型可以贡献被更昂贵配置所遗漏的发现。

paragraphs.en: We believe two things make AI-driven vulnerability research hard to measure. First, many high-profile zero-day or exploit-agent studies emphasize frontier models or limited model sets ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) , so we learn less about the cheaper or open-weight models a security team would be more willing to deploy. Second, many benchmarks target public, already-patched CVEs (mined from vulnerability-fixing commits or reused from known repositories). A success on public-vulnerability corpora can therefore reflect prior exposure rather than discovery, a data leakage and contamination risk recognized in vulnerability-evaluation work ( Ding et al., 2025 ; Ahmed et al., 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) . Newer work such as ZeroDayBench explicitly tries to avoid this with novel vulnerability tasks ( Lau et al., 2026 ; Feiglin and Dar, 2026 ) , but what is still missing is a real-code, multi-model, cost-aware measurement of how much the tools and context matter, and for whom ; we provide one, on a codebase whose vulnerabilities were non-public at scan time, and make the following contributions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为，有两点使得 AI 驱动的漏洞研究难以衡量。 首先，许多知名的零日漏洞或利用智能体（exploit-agent）研究都聚焦于前沿模型或有限的模型集合（Wang et al., 2025b；Zhu et al., 2026），因此我们对于安全团队更愿意部署的那些成本更低或开放权重的模型了解较少。 其次，许多基准测试针对的是公开的、已被修复的 CVE（从漏洞修复提交中挖掘或从已知仓库中复用）。 因此，在公开漏洞语料库上取得的成功可能反映的是此前已接触过这些漏洞，而非真正的发现，这是漏洞评估工作中已被指出的数据泄漏与污染风险（Ding et al., 2025；Ahmed et al., 2025；Cheng et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2025a）。 更新的工作（如 ZeroDayBench）明确尝试通过新颖的漏洞任务来避免这一问题（Lau et al., 2026；Feiglin and Dar, 2026），但仍然缺失的是一种基于真实代码、覆盖多模型、考虑成本的衡量方式，以测出工具与上下文究竟有多大影响、以及对谁而言如此；我们在一个扫描时其漏洞尚未公开的代码库上提供了这样的衡量，并做出以下贡献。

paragraphs.en: C1: A multi-model real-world performance study (§ 4.1 ), We tested 24 model–runner configurations using the same DeepSec pipeline on an open-source production codebase, comparing yield, false-report rate, cost, coverage, and finding classes. paragraphs.en: Agentic vulnerability discovery. The latest systems that find exploitable bugs in real software share a common anatomy: a language model wrapped in a harness of tools, context, and an iterative loop ( Glazunov and Brand, 2024 ; Big Sleep Team, 2024 ; Chang et al., 2024 ; DARPA, 2025 ; Kim et al., 2025 ) . Where they differ is in which harness ingredients they add, for example, a debugger and code browser ( Glazunov and Brand, 2024 ) , a fuzzing back-end ( Chang et al., 2024 ) , or a full end-to-end system that discovers, proves, and patches findings ( DARPA, 2025 ; Kim et al., 2025 ) . Each of these systems credits much of its capability to that scaffolding rather than to the bare model. What these lines of work do not isolate is how much the harness components contribute, or whether their value depends on the model they wrap. We hold these variables fixed within each operational model–runner configuration in the first experiment (24 configurations) and vary context arms across four configurations in the second.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体化漏洞发现。 在真实软件中发现可利用漏洞的最新系统具有共同的结构：一个语言模型被包裹在由工具、上下文和迭代循环构成的外壳中（Glazunov and Brand, 2024；Big Sleep Team, 2024；Chang et al., 2024；DARPA, 2025；Kim et al., 2025）。 它们的区别在于所添加的外壳组件不同，例如调试器和代码浏览器（Glazunov and Brand, 2024）、模糊测试后端（Chang et al., 2024），或是能够发现、证明并修补所发现问题的完整端到端系统（DARPA, 2025；Kim et al., 2025）。 这些系统都将其能力的很大一部分归功于这种脚手架，而非裸模型本身。 这些工作没有厘清的是，外壳组件究竟贡献了多少能力，以及它们的价值是否取决于所包裹的模型。 在第一个实验（24 种配置）中，我们在每个操作性的模型—运行器配置内部将这些变量固定，而在第二个实验中，我们在四种配置间变换上下文分支。

paragraphs.en: How discovery is measured, and the contamination problem. Evaluation methods are split by different tasks. Interactive CTF-style benchmarks such as Cybench ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) and NYU CTF Bench ( Shao et al., 2024 ) score exploitation of planted challenges rather than discovery in real repositories. Execution-grounded vulnerability benchmarks such as CyberGym ( Wang et al., 2025b ) and the ARVO corpus ( Mei et al., 2024 ) require a proof of concept that fires on the vulnerable version and not the fixed one, while CVE-Bench ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) validates successful exploits against sandboxed web-application attack goals. Label and localization datasets such as PrimeVul ( Ding et al., 2025 ) and SecVulEval ( Ahmed et al., 2025 ) evaluate vulnerability detection rather than open-ended discovery: PrimeVul is function-level, while SecVulEval adds statement-level labels and context. BountyBench ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) is the closest operational comparator, tying Detect/Exploit/Patch performance on real systems to bug-bounty dollar impact. CyberGym is the closest known-vulnerability reproduction setting to ours: it grades agents on reproducing real OSS vulnerabilities and explicitly varies disclosed information, including a Level-0 condition that withholds the description and approximates open-ended discovery. Two potential issues arise from benchmarks of this kind. The first is contamination : today’s models may already have been exposed during training to the very public signal these corpora are built from including CVE entries, security advisories, and the linked vulnerability-fixing commits and GitHub issue threads, a rich and heavily-scraped data source ( Dozono et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2023 ) . Therefore, a reproduced vulnerability may reflect a memorized disclosure rather than discovery, a recognized data-leakage risk in LLM-security evaluation ( Cheng et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) and only partly addressed by continuously-updated post-cutoff (LiveCVEBench / CVE-Factory ( Luo et al., 2026 ) ) or novel-vulnerability (ZeroDayBench ( Lau et al., 2026 ) ) designs. The second is target-oriented scoring : many known-vulnerability tasks define success against the selected CVE, patch, or attack objective, so off-target discoveries may not count toward the main metric unless separately analyzed; the metric tracks recall against a selected target, not discovery breadth.
paragraphs.zh: 发现如何度量，以及污染问题。 评估方法按不同任务划分。 交互式 CTF 风格的基准（如 Cybench（Zhang et al., 2024）和 NYU CTF Bench（Shao et al., 2024））评测的是对预置挑战的利用，而非在真实仓库中的发现。 以执行为依据的漏洞基准（如 CyberGym（Wang et al., 2025b）和 ARVO 语料库（Mei et al., 2024））要求一个概念验证能在易受攻击的版本上触发而在修复后的版本上不触发，而 CVE-Bench（Zhu et al., 2025）则针对沙箱化的 Web 应用攻击目标验证漏洞利用是否成功。 标签与定位数据集（如 PrimeVul（Ding et al., 2025）和 SecVulEval（Ahmed et al., 2025））评估的是漏洞检测而非开放式发现：PrimeVul 是函数级的，而 SecVulEval 增加了语句级标签和上下文。 BountyBench（Zhang et al., 2025）是最接近的运营性对比对象，它将真实系统上的 Detect/Exploit/Patch 表现与漏洞赏金的美元影响挂钩。 CyberGym 是与我们最接近的已知漏洞复现场景：它考察智能体复现真实开源软件漏洞的能力，并明确变化已披露的信息，其中包括一个 Level-0 条件，即不提供漏洞描述，从而近似开放式发现。 这类基准会带来两个潜在问题。 第一个是污染：如今的模型在训练中可能已经接触过这些语料库所依据的公开信号本身，包括 CVE 条目、安全公告，以及相关的漏洞修复提交和 GitHub 议题讨论串——这是一个丰富且被大量爬取的数据来源（Dozono et al., 2025；Li et al., 2023）。 因此，复现出的漏洞可能反映的是对已披露信息的记忆而非发现，这是 LLM 安全评估中公认的数据泄露风险（Cheng et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2025a），而持续更新的截止日期之后（LiveCVEBench / CVE-Factory（Luo et al., 2026））或新型漏洞（ZeroDayBench（Lau et al., 2026））的设计只能部分解决这一问题。 第二个是面向目标的评分：许多已知漏洞任务以选定的 CVE、补丁或攻击目标来定义成功，因此偏离目标的发现可能不计入主指标，除非另行分析；该指标衡量的是针对选定目标的召回率，而非发现的广度。

paragraphs.en: Harness and interface engineering. Beyond the base model, a growing body of work shows that LLM performance depends sharply on the harness : prompt and interface design, context selection and placement, tool affordances, feedback loops, and model-specific adaptation. The agent–computer interface alone materially changes software-agent success rates ( Yang et al., 2024 ) ; semantically equivalent prompt and context formats produce very different results, and by different amounts across models ( Sclar et al., 2024 ) ; longer context is not automatically more useful context ( Liu et al., 2024 ) ; and irrelevant retrieved context can actively degrade performance ( Yoran et al., 2024 ) . What is missing, and what we provide, is a security-focused, multi-model measurement of which tools and context additions help which models.
paragraphs.zh: 测试框架与接口工程。 在基础模型之外，越来越多研究表明，大语言模型（LLM）的性能在很大程度上取决于测试框架：提示词与界面设计、上下文的选择与放置、工具的可供性、反馈回路以及针对特定模型的适配。 仅智能体—计算机接口本身就会显著改变软件智能体的成功率（Yang et al., 2024）；语义上等价的提示词与上下文格式会产生截然不同的结果，且差异幅度在不同模型间各不相同（Sclar et al., 2024）；更长的上下文并不自动等于更有用的上下文（Liu et al., 2024）；而检索到的无关上下文甚至会主动降低性能（Yoran et al., 2024）。 目前缺失的、也正是我们所提供的，是一套以安全为核心、覆盖多模型的测量，用于判定哪些工具和上下文增补对哪些模型有帮助。

sents.en: The agent–computer interface alone materially changes software-agent success rates ( Yang et al., 2024 ) ; semantically equivalent prompt and context formats produce very different results, and by different amounts across models ( Sclar et al., 2024 ) ; longer context is not automatically more useful context ( Liu et al., 2024 ) ; and irrelevant retrieved context can actively degrade performance ( Yoran et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 仅智能体—计算机接口本身就会显著改变软件智能体的成功率（Yang et al., 2024）；语义上等价的提示词与上下文格式会产生截然不同的结果，且差异幅度在不同模型间各不相同（Sclar et al., 2024）；更长的上下文并不自动等于更有用的上下文（Liu et al., 2024）；而检索到的无关上下文甚至会主动降低性能（Yoran et al., 2024）。

sents.en: What is missing, and what we provide, is a security-focused, multi-model measurement of which tools and context additions help which models.
sents.zh: 目前缺失的、也正是我们所提供的，是一套以安全为核心、覆盖多模型的测量，用于判定哪些工具和上下文增补对哪些模型有帮助。

paragraphs.en: Context, scaffolding, and the capability-dependent effect. Program structure can support vulnerability detection by providing context beyond individual functions. Yildiz et al. ( 2025 ) show that real-world vulnerability detection often requires interprocedural analysis because vulnerabilities can span multiple function calls. In their JITVUL benchmark, ReAct agents that retrieve caller and callee context on demand achieved higher pairwise accuracy than plain LLM baselines, although plain and dependency-augmented LLMs often achieved higher F1 scores. With ”IRIS”, Li et al ( 2024 ) use an LLM to infer taint specifications that sharpen a static analyzer while Hai et al’s ( 2025 ) repository-level study finds that how well a model uses cross-file and dependency context varies by model and by the form that context takes. Our primary arm is conceptually rooted in code-property-graph vulnerability discovery ( Yamaguchi et al., 2014 ) and operationalized with CodeQL’s queryable semantic code database ( GitHub, 2024 ) ; but where IRIS infers specifications to feed a static analyzer, we instead ask how that static call and reachability context changes the behavior of different LLM agents . General NLP and agent work suggests both upside and risk: retrieval ( Borgeaud et al., 2021 ; Izacard et al., 2022 ) and tool or agent scaffolding ( Yao et al., 2022 ; Schick et al., 2023 ) let smaller models perform tasks they otherwise fail, so the direction of our headline effect is unsurprising. Yet, as the harness-engineering results above show, added context can equally be ignored, misplaced, or actively harmful when irrelevant. Source-derived context is therefore a harness intervention whose value must be resolved empirically by model, task, and cost, not assumed from aggregate benchmark performance.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文、脚手架与能力依赖性效应。 程序结构可以通过提供超越单个函数的上下文来支持漏洞检测。Yildiz 等人 （2025）指出，真实世界的漏洞检测往往需要过程间分析，因为漏洞可能跨越多个函数调用。 在他们的 JITVUL 基准测试中，按需检索调用者与被调用者上下文的 ReAct 智能体获得了比纯 LLM 基线更高的成对准确率，尽管纯 LLM 和依赖增强型 LLM 往往取得了更高的 F1 分数。 在 "IRIS" 中，Li 等人（2024）使用 LLM 推断污点规范以强化静态分析器，而 Hai 等人（2025）的仓库级研究发现，模型利用跨文件和依赖上下文的效果因模型和上下文的形式而异。 我们的主实验路径在概念上根植于代码属性图漏洞发现（Yamaguchi 等，2014），并通过 CodeQL 可查询的语义代码数据库（GitHub，2024）加以实现；但 IRIS 是推断规范以供静态分析器使用，我们则反过来探究这种静态调用与可达性上下文如何改变不同 LLM 智能体的行为。 一般的 NLP 与智能体研究表明既有机遇也有风险：检索（Borgeaud 等，2021；Izacard 等，2022）以及工具或智能体脚手架（Yao 等，2022；Schick 等，2023）能让较小的模型完成它们原本无法完成的任务，因此我们核心效应的方向并不令人意外。 然而，正如上述测试框架工程的结果所示，新增的上下文同样可能被忽略、用错位置，或在无关时反而造成危害。 因此，源自源代码的上下文是一种测试框架干预，其价值必须根据模型、任务和成本通过实证来确定，而不能从总体基准表现中想当然地推断。

paragraphs.en: Controlling false reports. In a real-world context, yield and precision both matter, but candidate findings generally require expert verification, so a model’s false-report rate is a major determinant of the human cost of acting on its output ( Wu et al., 2025 ) . Further, LLM judges are scalable but gameable: superficial inputs can inflate their false-positive rewards without substantive reasoning ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) . We therefore use self-revalidation only as a precision filter: the reported counts retain findings that survive this filter and deduplication, rather than treating the model’s second opinion as independent proof. Executable PoCs provide a stronger confirmation tier, where feasible, and are required before a finding is promoted to maintainer-facing disclosure. Positioning. Our contribution is a controlled, capability-resolved measurement of how deterministic, source-derived context changes an LLM vulnerability-discovery harness on real code, answering which models it helps and when it fails to help.

paragraphs.en: Target and oracle. Only findings it keeps as true-positive enter the primary analysis. The staged review pipeline then maps, independently reviews, and actively confirms retained findings. paragraphs.en: Why self-revalidation. Letting each model re-judge its own findings is a deliberate precision filter that reflects real-world usage: a practitioner would not typically act on unfiltered model output. The filter is beneficial but not lossless, since a model can reject a finding that was in fact a true positive. We report how much it helps, and what it discards, on the benchmark in § 4.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 为什么采用自我复核。 让每个模型重新评判其自身的发现是一种有意的精确率过滤器，它反映了真实世界的使用情况：从业者通常不会直接依据未经过滤的模型输出采取行动。 这一过滤器是有益的，但并非无损，因为模型可能会拒绝一个实际上为真阳性的发现。 我们在第4.1节的基准测试中报告了它带来了多大帮助，以及它丢弃了什么。

paragraphs.en: Contamination control. Conduit ’s source is public and plausibly present in training, but our findings were not publicly disclosed at the time of our scan. This reduces the risk of recalling published vulnerability labels, although it cannot exclude prior exposure to the source or related defects. As external evidence that the methodology surfaces genuine issues, the same pipeline applied to other open-source libraries and repositories received positive maintainer feedback and has produced reports that were subsequently assigned CVEs. paragraphs.en: Security vs. correctness findings. A single Process pass emits two kinds of findings at once: security vulnerabilities and ordinary correctness or logic defects. The agent is asked to classify each finding as a bug or security vulnerability with a severity classification. Every security vulnerability is also a software defect, but not every defect is a security vulnerability. A correctness bug becomes a security finding only when it is attacker-reachable and carries a security consequence: a crash on attacker input is a denial-of-service vulnerability, while the same crash on a malformed internal config is just a bug. The security track is therefore the security-relevant subset of everything the agent surfaces, and reporting only it would throw away the rest of the agent’s useful output. We therefore report both separately. The agent’s initial labels enter a canonical review that applies the attacker-reachability rule above: Critical/High/Medium/Low are security , and High-bug/Bug are correctness bugs . Security is our primary track and we report it first, but we give the correctness-bug yield and a separate bug false-report rate alongside it, since a model precise on one need not be precise on the other.
paragraphs.zh: 安全性与正确性发现结果。 Process 的单次处理会同时产出两类发现结果：安全漏洞和普通正确性或逻辑缺陷。 要求智能体将每条发现结果分类为漏洞或安全漏洞，并给出严重程度分级。 每个安全漏洞也都是软件缺陷，但并非每个缺陷都是安全漏洞。 只有当正确性缺陷可被攻击者触达并带来安全后果时，它才会成为安全发现结果：攻击者输入导致的崩溃是拒绝服务漏洞，而同样的崩溃若由内部格式错误的配置导致，则只是缺陷。 因此，安全赛道是智能体所呈现的所有内容中与安全相关的子集，若只报告这一部分，就会丢弃智能体其余有用的输出。 因此我们将两者分开报告。 智能体的初始标签会进入一个规范化审查流程，该流程应用上述的攻击者可达性规则：Critical/High/Medium/Low 为安全问题，High-bug/Bug 为正确性缺陷。 安全是我们的主要赛道并优先报告，但我们同时给出正确性缺陷的产出以及单独的缺陷误报率，因为在其中一个方面精确的模型未必在另一个方面也精确。

paragraphs.en: Self-revalidation acts as a filter. We separately reviewed all 1,350 reports that were dropped in the 24 model–run during the self-revalidation. Of these, 118 lacked a self-verdict and so were not considered further. Among the 1,232 explicit model exclusions, later review classified 680 reports as true positives, 541 as false positives, and 11 as uncertain. Report counts overstate capability loss: models often rejected a duplicate report after retaining the same canonical identity elsewhere in the run. After per-run canonical deduplication, the 24 cells retained 3,979 confirmed identity credits and explicitly excluded 455 identities that they had not retained elsewhere. Self-revalidation is therefore useful for controlling output volume, but it also discards valid identities, and its strictness differs substantially by model.
paragraphs.zh: 自我复核充当一种过滤器。 我们单独审查了在 24 个智能体运行期间的自我复核中被剔除的全部 1,350 份报告。 其中，118 份报告缺少自我判定，因此未作进一步考虑。 在 1,232 份由模型明确排除的报告之中，后续审查将 680 份归类为真阳性，541 份归类为假阳性，11 份归类为不确定。 报告数量夸大了能力损失：智能体在保留同一规范身份于运行中其他位置之后，往往会拒绝重复报告。 经过逐次运行的规范身份去重后，24 个单元格保留了 3,979 个已确认的身份积分，并明确排除了 455 个未在其他位置保留的身份。 因此，自我复核对于控制输出数量是有用的，但它也会丢弃有效身份，并且其严格程度在不同智能体之间差异很大。

paragraphs.en: Severity weighting tells the same story. Not every finding carries equal weight, so we also score each security finding by severity (Critical 5 down to Low 2, correctness bugs excluded). On this criticality-weighted score the lift from A0 to the engineered prompt with CodeQL context again declines monotonically with capability (Figure 1 ): Gemma + 86 % +86\% ( → 100.5 54\!\to\!100.5 ), GLM + 36 % +36\% ( → 160.5 118\!\to\!160.5 ), Composer + 20 % +20\% ( → 309 258.5\!\to\!309 ), and GPT-5.5 + 2 % +2\% ( → 311.5 305.5\!\to\!311.5 , within run-to-run noise). The engineered A1 prompt improves raw security yield over A0 for all four models. The incremental codeql-cpg block improves on A1 only for Gemma in this experiment (Section 17 ).

paragraphs.en: Why the effect is capability-dependent. Two mechanisms are consistent with the pattern. (i) Headroom / under-elicitation: at A0 the small and mid-tier models give shallow, early-terminating reviews; call-graph and source/sink context supplies source → \to sink reachability they may not derive unaided. (ii) Saturation or dilution: context a strong model does not need can lengthen the prompt without adding useful evidence. For Composer, codeql-cpg raises yield by 14.5, but the other context arms range from − 5.5 -5.5 to + 5.0 +5.0 relative to A0. For GPT-5.5, codeql-cpg leaves yield unchanged while reducing the false-report rate from 10.0% to 5.3%.
paragraphs.zh: 为什么该效应依赖于能力水平。 有两种机制可以解释这一模式。 （一）余量不足/引导不足：在 A0 下，小型和中等规模模型给出的评审较为浅显、过早终止；调用图与 source/sink 上下文提供了它们可能无法独立推导出的 source → \to sink 可达性信息。 （二）饱和或稀释：对强模型而言不需要的上下文，只会在不增加有用证据的情况下拉长提示词。 对于 Composer，codeql-cpg 将产出提升了 14.5，但其他上下文组相对于 A0 的变化范围在 − 5.5 -5.5 到 + 5.0 +5.0 之间。 对于 GPT-5.5，codeql-cpg 在保持产出不变的同时，将误报率从 10.0% 降至 5.3%。

paragraphs.en: Does the benefit survive outside Conduit ? To find out, we ran the same harness and the same codeql-cpg context arm on a subset of CyberGym Level-0 ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , a deliberately distant setting, in a different language and codebase (real-world C/C++ projects rather than the TypeScript API-gateway) and on a different vulnerability corpus. Across 21 reviewed C/C++ instances, each with a known upstream vulnerability, we ask whether a model finds that vulnerability in the known-vulnerable file, under the base harness versus the enhanced context arm (Table 5 ). All four models improve with context (Composer → 19 17\!\to\!19 , GPT-5.5 → 15 14\!\to\!15 , GLM-5.1 → 10 8\!\to\!10 , Gemma → 5 4\!\to\!5 ), so the direction of the harness effect carries across language and codebase, not just within the original repository.
paragraphs.zh: 这种收益在 Conduit 之外是否仍然成立？ 为了弄清这一点，我们在 CyberGym Level-0（Wang et al., 2025b）的一个子集上运行了相同的测试框架和相同的 codeql-cpg 上下文组，这是一个刻意选取的远距设定，使用不同的语言和代码库（真实世界的 C/C++ 项目而非 TypeScript API 网关），并且使用了不同的漏洞语料库。 在 21 个经过审查的 C/C++ 实例（每个实例都有一个已知上游漏洞）上，我们探究模型在基础测试框架与增强上下文组的对比下，能否在已知存在漏洞的文件中找到该漏洞（表 5）。 全部四个模型都因上下文而提升（Composer → 19 17\!\to\!19，GPT-5.5 → 15 14\!\to\!15，GLM-5.1 → 10 8\!\to\!10，Gemma → 5 4\!\to\!5），因此测试框架效应的方向能够跨语言和代码库迁移，而不仅限于原始仓库内部。

paragraphs.en: A single scan substantially under-counts what even one model finds, and no single model is sufficient. In § 4.1 we ran DeepSec (equivalent to A1 in § 4.2 ) twice for all 24 configurations; the full per-run table is in Section 16 . Run-to-run overlap of externally confirmed security root causes is modest (per-model Jaccard 0.35 0.35 – 0.83 0.83 ), so an average run recovers roughly 68 68 – 91 % 91\% of a model’s two-run confirmed set. Across models the effect compounds: the two-run security union contains 265 root causes, while the strongest two-run configuration, GLM-5.3, finds 160 ( 60.4% ). Of the union, 38/265 ( 14.3% ) are found by exactly one model; over both tracks, 219/776 (28.2%) are single-model root causes. Discovery is therefore non-deterministic within a model and complementary across models, an argument for repetition and ensembling rather than a single-run, single-model leaderboard. The best execution-grounded benchmarks already adopt this: CVE-Bench ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , for example, repeats each setting five times and reports success rates with one or five attempts, including success@5, rather than relying on a single trial.
paragraphs.zh: 单次扫描会明显低估即使是单个模型所能发现的问题，且没有任何单一模型是足够可靠的。 在 §4.1 中，我们对全部 24 种配置运行了两次 DeepSec（相当于 §4.2 中的 A1）；完整的逐次运行表格见第 16 节。 外部确认的安全根因在多次运行之间的重合度较低（每个模型的 Jaccard 系数为 0.35–0.83），因此单次运行平均只能恢复某个模型两次运行确认集的约 68–91%。 跨模型来看，这一效应会叠加：两次运行的安全并集包含 265 个根因，而最强的两次运行配置 GLM-5.3 仅发现 160 个（60.4%）。 在该并集中，38/265（14.3%）仅由恰好一个模型发现；在两条测试轨道上，776 个中有 219 个（28.2%）是单一模型的根因。 因此，发现过程在单个模型内部是非确定性的，而在不同模型之间是互补的，这论证了重复运行与集成方法的必要性，而非单次运行、单一模型的排行榜。 最佳的基于实际执行的基准测试已经采用了这一做法：例如 CVE-Bench（Zhu et al., 2025）将每种设置重复五次，并报告一次或五次尝试的成功率（包括 success@5），而不是依赖单次试验。

paragraphs.en: What helps broadly, and what helps whom. A strong general harness (the engineered A1 prompt, with its role context priming, a vulnerability-category table, and false-positive and mitigation guidance) lifts all four models above the minimal baseline. Targeted source-derived context is model- and task-dependent. Relative to A0, its raw-yield benefit concentrates in the smaller and cheaper models and is absent for GPT-5.5.
paragraphs.zh: 什么能带来广泛帮助，以及什么能帮助谁。 一个强大的通用工具链（经过工程化的 A1 提示词，包含其角色上下文引导、漏洞类别表以及误报和缓解指导）将全部四个模型的性能提升到最小基线之上。 有针对性的、源自源代码的上下文其效果取决于模型和任务。 相对于 A0，其原始产出收益集中在较小、较便宜的模型上，而对 GPT-5.5 则不存在这种收益。

paragraphs.en: No single harness fits every model. The targeted-context gain is not just smaller for stronger models; its shape differs too. Layered on top of the engineered prompt A1, source-derived context adds to the engineered prompt only for Gemma in this experiment. For the other three models, the engineered prompt captures more signal than the primary context arm (Section 17 ); which context arm helps most varies by model (Table 4 ). Consistent per-model gains therefore come from matching harness engineering, prompt and context together, to the model rather than from one universal recipe. Practitioner reports point the same way: XBOW found that the newer Opus 4.7 had to be driven differently, re-prompted to suit the model, to realise its gains in offensive-security workflows ( Ziegler, 2026 ) , the same lesson our A0/A1/context decomposition shows quantitatively across different models.

paragraphs.en: These context experiments are small (four models, two runs), so their numbers are best read as approximate effect sizes rather than precise measurements. The main caveats follow.

paragraphs.en: Two runs per treatment cell. We report two-run means, but run-to-run variation is large: a model’s A0 security yield can shift by a third between runs, so the four-point trend gives the size and direction of the effect.

paragraphs.en: Prompt engineering not separated from context. The headline compares A0 (no scaffolding) to codeql-cpg (engineered prompt + + CodeQL context), so the reported lift is the combined harness change (engineered prompt and source-derived context), not the context alone. All four models have an A1 engineered-prompt baseline, and A1 improves yield over A0 for each model. Relative to A1, the incremental CodeQL block raises yield only for Gemma and lowers it for GPT-5.5, Composer, and GLM. The untargeted context-gathering arm also adds tokens while lowering yield. These decompositions rule out a universal “more prompt or more tokens” explanation, but do not isolate a single causal ingredient in the headline A0–CodeQL comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 提示词工程未与上下文分离。 标题中的对比是 A0（无脚手架）与 codeql-cpg（工程化提示词 + CodeQL 上下文）之间的对比，因此所报告的提升来自整体框架变化（工程化提示词与源自源码的上下文）的组合，而非仅来自上下文。 四个模型都有 A1 工程化提示词基线，且对每个模型而言，A1 的产出率都高于 A0。 相对于 A1，增量式 CodeQL 块仅对 Gemma 提升了产出率，而对 GPT-5.5、Composer 和 GLM 则降低了产出率。 非定向的上下文获取分支同样在增加 token 的同时降低了产出率。 这些分解排除了“更多提示词或更多 token”这一普适性解释，但并未在标题中的 A0–CodeQL 对比里分离出单一因果因素。

paragraphs.en: Model–harness confounding. C1 crosses neither models nor harness: GPT uses Codex, Composer and Grok use Cursor, the Claude models use the Claude Agent SDK (Claude Code harness), GLM-5.3-Flash uses OpenCode, and the OpenRouter models use mini-SWE-agent. Reasoning controls also differ by runner. C1 therefore measures operational model–runner configurations. Cross-configuration differences in yield, false-report rate, finding-class mix, and cost can reflect runner tools, policies, and reasoning settings as well as the model. Within-model C2 comparisons provide cleaner evidence about context interventions.

paragraphs.en: False-report rates follow a two-stage filter. The originating model first judges its own findings in a separate thread. We compare findings that survive self-validation with the canonical list, which avoids repeating review for previously validated or rejected findings. Each net new finding judged then undergoes source review by a model from a different family and active PoC confirmation (Section 13 ). The reported false-report rate is the rejected or unresolved share of the self-filtered set. It therefore reflects both discovery quality and the strictness of the model’s self-judge. We retain self-rejected findings and send them through the same later stages for the separate self-adjudication analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 虚报率遵循一个两阶段过滤流程。 产生发现的模型首先在一个独立线程中自行评判其发现。 我们将通过自验证的发现与权威列表进行比对，从而避免对先前已验证或已被否决的发现重复进行审查。 每个被判为全新发现的条目随后由来自不同系列的模型进行来源审查，并进行主动 PoC 确认（见第 13 节）。 所报告的虚报率是经自过滤集合中被否决或未获解决的发现所占的比例。 因此，该指标同时反映了发现的质量和模型自我评判的严格程度。 我们保留被自我否决的发现，并将其送入相同的后续阶段，用于独立的自我裁定分析。

paragraphs.en: Cost is experienced or API-equivalent, not normalized. OpenRouter cells use provider-reported cost, while local subscription cells use token-derived or SDK-reported API-equivalent values. The reported model-run costs cover discovery and model self-revalidation; they do not include the shared canonical-mapping, independent-review, and proof-confirmation work. They are not end-to-end validation costs. GLM-5.3-Flash ran free under its Ox Alpha preview name; we estimate its current cost from recorded input, cache-read, and output tokens at standard launch list rates. The resulting $/vuln values describe experienced or API-equivalent cost classes, not a provider-neutral price benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 成本为实际发生成本或等效 API 成本，未经归一化。 OpenRouter 单元使用供应商报告的成本，而本地订阅单元使用基于 token 推算或 SDK 报告的等效 API 数值。 报告的模型运行成本涵盖发现与模型自验证，不包括共享的规范映射、独立审查与证明确认工作。 它们并非端到端验证成本。 GLM-5.3-Flash 以其 Ox Alpha 预览名称免费运行；我们根据记录的输入、缓存读取与输出 token，按标准发布牌价估算其当前成本。 由此得到的 $/vuln 数值描述的是实际发生成本或等效 API 成本类别，并非供应商中立的定价基准。

paragraphs.en: We also flag a limit on what “vulnerability” means here. Although our pipeline labels these findings as vulnerabilities and the code may well be exploitable in isolation, a maintainer may reasonably treat some of them as accepted risk, or may already mitigate them through compensating controls that sit outside the source we analyze, such as upstream authentication, network policy, rate limiting, or deployment hardening. Our counts therefore describe what the harness surfaces and confirms, not a maintainer-adjudicated severity ledger, which is also why we report post-review canonical severities as triage labels.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还需指出此处“漏洞”一词含义上的局限。 尽管我们的流水线将这些发现标记为漏洞，且这些代码在孤立来看很可能确实可被利用，但维护者可能合理地将其中一些视为已接受的风险，或者可能已经通过位于我们所分析源代码之外的补偿性控制措施（如上游身份验证、网络策略、速率限制或部署加固）缓解了它们。 因此，我们的统计数字描述的是测试框架所发现并确认的内容，而非经维护者裁定的严重性台账，这也是我们为何将评审后的标准严重性作为分诊标签来报告的原因。

paragraphs.en: First, the models are complementary. Across 265 externally confirmed security root causes observed in C1, the strongest two-run configuration covers 60.4%, and 14.3% appear in exactly one model’s two-run set. A single run also recovers only 68–91% of its model’s two-run set. Coverage therefore comes from repetition and from combining configurations rather than from one scan of one model.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，这些模型是互补的。 在 C1 中观察到的 265 个经外部确认的安全根因中，最强的两次运行配置覆盖了 60.4%，而有 14.3% 仅出现在某一个模型的两次运行集合中。 单次运行也只能恢复其模型两次运行集合的 68–91%。 因此，覆盖率来自重复运行和组合不同配置，而不是来自对单一模型的一次扫描。

sents.en: First, the models are complementary.
sents.zh: 首先，这些模型是互补的。

sents.en: Across 265 externally confirmed security root causes observed in C1, the strongest two-run configuration covers 60.4%, and 14.3% appear in exactly one model’s two-run set.
sents.zh: 在 C1 中观察到的 265 个经外部确认的安全根因中，最强的两次运行配置覆盖了 60.4%，而有 14.3% 仅出现在某一个模型的两次运行集合中。

sents.en: A single run also recovers only 68–91% of its model’s two-run set.
sents.zh: 单次运行也只能恢复其模型两次运行集合的 68–91%。

sents.en: Coverage therefore comes from repetition and from combining configurations rather than from one scan of one model.
sents.zh: 因此，覆盖率来自重复运行和组合不同配置，而不是来自对单一模型的一次扫描。

paragraphs.en: Second, the payoff from added context depends on baseline capability, and it is largest for the cheaper models a team would deploy for cost reasons. Weighting findings by severity tells the same story: the criticality-weighted lift falls from + 86 % +86\% for the smallest model to + 2 % +2\% at the frontier.

paragraphs.en: Per-model base harness. All models run the same DeepSec Scan/Process/Revalidate pipeline, but through different base harnesses: Claude Agent SDK (Opus 4.6, Opus 4.8, Opus 5), Codex SDK (GPT-5.5, GPT-5.6 Luna, GPT-5.6 Sol), Cursor Agent CLI (Composer-2.5, Grok 4.6 High), OpenCode CLI (GLM-5.3-Flash, tested as Ox Alpha), and a mini-SWE-agent bash harness ( SWE-agent Team, 2025 ) with model access via OpenRouter (GLM-5.1, GLM-5.3, DeepSeek-v4, DeepSeek V4 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813, Minimax-M3, Kimi K2.6, Kimi K3, Qwen 3.7 Max, Qwen 3.8 (27B), Muse Glimmer 30B, Inkling, Gemini-3.5-Flash, Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite, and Gemma-4-31B). We use mini-SWE-agent for the open-weight lane because it is a minimal, provider-agnostic bash-tool ReAct loop ( Yao et al., 2022 ) with no vendor-specific scaffolding. A single harness therefore drives the OpenRouter-hosted models through a shared agent loop, subject to the documented transport differences. We used the model catalogs available through each SDK or CLI; Cursor hosted both Composer and Grok. A minimal shared agent makes the OpenRouter lane easier to compare ( SWE-agent Team, 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) . This harness asymmetry is nonetheless a confounder we flag explicitly (§ 7 ): cross-model differences reflect the harness as well as the model, part of why we read cross-model false-report rates as indicative rather than as a clean precision ranking.

paragraphs.en: GPT used the interface in every eligible batch, but hybrid still underperformed static call-graph-enrichment , consistent with query/tool overhead and the loss of comprehensive up-front facts. GLM adopted it often but mostly requested broad summaries or attack-surface views, while Gemma mostly ignored or mis-invoked it. paragraphs.en: Deduplication detail. We map individual self-revalidated reports rather than incrementally extending model-specific groups. We first split bundled reports into atomic claims and retain each parent link. File, line, title, and description retrieve possible canonical matches. A separate mapping pass assigns each report to an existing identity or proposes a new one. Canonical matching is the hardest part of scaling the study. Models often describe the same root cause with different wording or locations, while some reports combine several causes. We therefore preserve every report-to-identity link, review ambiguous matches, and audit the complete identity set for missed merges and splits. Independent model reviews examine disputed identity boundaries and source-grounded reviews resolve remaining track, severity, and attack-chain conflicts. The final accounting joins each source report to its reviewed identity and gives each model–run cell at most one credit for that identity. The final corpus contains 1,091 identities: 841 true positives, 243 false positives, and 7 uncertain records. The observed C1 union contains 265 security roots and 511 correctness defects; an item cannot contribute to both tracks.
paragraphs.zh: 去重细节。 我们对单个经过自我复核的报告进行映射，而不是以增量方式扩展特定模型的分组。 我们首先将捆绑的报告拆分为原子性声明，并保留每个父链接。 文件、行号、标题和描述用于检索可能的规范匹配。 由单独的映射步骤将每份报告分配给某个已有身份，或提出一个新身份。 规范匹配是扩展本研究规模时最困难的部分。 各模型常用不同的措辞或位置描述同一根本原因，而某些报告则合并了多个原因。 因此，我们保留每一条报告到身份的链接，审查含糊的匹配，并对完整的身份集合进行审计，以发现遗漏的合并与拆分。 独立的模型评审会检查存在争议的身份边界，基于来源的评审则解决剩余的轨道、严重性和攻击链冲突。 最终的统计将每份来源报告关联到其经评审的身份，并对每个模型–运行单元就同一身份至多计一次分。 最终语料库包含 1,091 个身份：841 个真阳性、243 个假阳性，以及 7 条不确定记录。 观察到的 C1 并集包含 265 个安全类根本原因和 511 个正确性缺陷；一个条目不能同时计入两个轨道。

sents.en: The final accounting joins each source report to its reviewed identity and gives each model–run cell at most one credit for that identity.

paragraphs.en: Confirmation tiers. The final stages grade each surviving finding on a six-level scale. T0 is the model’s unverified report. T1 survives context-free self-revalidation on a source reading. At T2 , a model that did not originate the candidate reviews it and does not refute it. At T3 , an executable PoC reproduces the issue against a local checkout. At T4 , the same PoC fires against the vulnerable code and not against the patched code; and T5 maintainer- or CVE-confirmed. Existing canonical matches retain their reviewed terminal evidence. New identities enter the headline metrics only after an isolated proof or reproduction exits successfully. We require executable confirmation before promoting a finding to maintainer-facing disclosure.
paragraphs.zh: 确认分级。 最终阶段按六级量表对每个存续的发现进行评级。 T0 是模型未经核实的报告。 T1 在对源码阅读进行无上下文自我复验后仍成立。 在 T2，一个未提出该候选发现的模型对其进行审查且未反驳它。 在 T3，一个可执行的 PoC 在本地检出上复现该问题。 在 T4，同一 PoC 在易受攻击的代码上触发而在修补后的代码上不触发；T5 为维护者或 CVE 确认。 已有的规范匹配保留其已审查的终端证据。 新的标识只有在独立的证明或复现成功退出后才会进入核心指标。 我们要求可执行的确认之后，才能将一个发现提升为面向维护者的披露。

paragraphs.en: Summary. Conduit lets a caller influence the outbound provider destination through a request-supplied host override (via header or routing config). At the audited revision the override is validated inconsistently: a deprecated proxy route skips request validation entirely, only one spelling of the routing field is checked, and local/development hosts are implicitly trusted when the trusted-host list is empty. The final provider URL is then fetched with no destination check, and provider fetches follow redirects automatically.
paragraphs.zh: 摘要。 Conduit 允许调用方通过请求提供的主机覆盖（经由请求头或路由配置）影响出站提供商目的地。 在被审计的版本中，该覆盖的验证不一致：一条已弃用的代理路由完全跳过请求验证，路由字段仅检查一种拼写，且当受信任主机列表为空时本地/开发主机会被隐式信任。 最终的提供商 URL 随后在无目的地检查的情况下被获取，且提供商获取会自动跟随重定向。

sents.en: Summary.
sents.zh: 摘要。

sents.en: Conduit lets a caller influence the outbound provider destination through a request-supplied host override (via header or routing config).
sents.zh: Conduit 允许调用方通过请求提供的主机覆盖（经由请求头或路由配置）影响出站提供商目的地。

sents.en: At the audited revision the override is validated inconsistently: a deprecated proxy route skips request validation entirely, only one spelling of the routing field is checked, and local/development hosts are implicitly trusted when the trusted-host list is empty.
sents.zh: 在被审计的版本中，该覆盖的验证不一致：一条已弃用的代理路由完全跳过请求验证，路由字段仅检查一种拼写，且当受信任主机列表为空时本地/开发主机会被隐式信任。

sents.en: The final provider URL is then fetched with no destination check, and provider fetches follow redirects automatically.
sents.zh: 最终的提供商 URL 随后在无目的地检查的情况下被获取，且提供商获取会自动跟随重定向。

paragraphs.en: Impact. A caller who can set the routing override can send provider requests, including the attached provider credentials, to an unintended host: loopback or cloud-metadata services in a self-hosted deployment, or an attacker-controlled endpoint that captures the forwarded authorization material. A redirect from an initially accepted host reaches the same outcome. The issue is server-side request forgery (CWE-918) compounded by credential exposure (CWE-200).
paragraphs.zh: 影响。 能够设置路由覆盖的调用方可以将提供商请求（包括随附的提供商凭据）发送到非预期的主机：在自托管部署中是回环地址或云元数据服务，或者是捕获被转发授权材料的攻击者控制的端点。 来自最初被接受的主机的重定向也会导致相同的结果。 该问题是服务端请求伪造（CWE-918），并因凭据暴露（CWE-200）而加剧。

sents.en: Impact.
sents.zh: 影响。

sents.en: A caller who can set the routing override can send provider requests, including the attached provider credentials, to an unintended host: loopback or cloud-metadata services in a self-hosted deployment, or an attacker-controlled endpoint that captures the forwarded authorization material.
sents.zh: 能够设置路由覆盖的调用方可以将提供商请求（包括随附的提供商凭据）发送到非预期的主机：在自托管部署中是回环地址或云元数据服务，或者是捕获被转发授权材料的攻击者控制的端点。

paragraphs.en: Root cause and preconditions. No single authoritative guard validates the final outbound URL; the checks that exist are spread across middleware that the deprecated route bypasses and that misses field-name and redirect variants. Preconditions: the caller can reach the provider proxy route and supply a routing override, and the deployment has not populated an explicit trusted-host allow-list.
paragraphs.zh: 根本原因与前提条件。 没有单一的权威守卫来校验最终的出站 URL；现有的检查分散在中间件中，而已弃用的路由绕过了这些中间件，并且这些中间件未覆盖字段名变体和重定向变体。 前提条件：调用方能够访问提供方代理路由并提供路由覆盖，且部署尚未填充显式的可信主机允许列表。

sents.en: Root cause and preconditions.
sents.zh: 根本原因与前提条件。

sents.en: No single authoritative guard validates the final outbound URL; the checks that exist are spread across middleware that the deprecated route bypasses and that misses field-name and redirect variants.
sents.zh: 没有单一的权威守卫来校验最终的出站 URL；现有的检查分散在中间件中，而已弃用的路由绕过了这些中间件，并且这些中间件未覆盖字段名变体和重定向变体。

sents.en: Preconditions: the caller can reach the provider proxy route and supply a routing override, and the deployment has not populated an explicit trusted-host allow-list.
sents.zh: 前提条件：调用方能够访问提供方代理路由并提供路由覆盖，且部署尚未填充显式的可信主机允许列表。

paragraphs.en: Remediation. Validate the final outbound URL at a single choke point immediately before the provider fetch; require routing overrides to match an explicit trusted-host allow-list, checking every field spelling and nested target; apply the same validation to the deprecated proxy route; and disable automatic redirect-following on provider fetches so a redirect cannot escape the destination check.
paragraphs.zh: 修复措施。 在提供方抓取前的单一收口点对最终出站 URL 进行校验；要求路由覆盖必须匹配显式的可信主机允许列表，检查每个字段拼写及嵌套目标；对已弃用的代理路由应用同样的校验；并禁用提供方抓取的自动重定向跟随，使重定向无法绕过目标检查。

sents.en: Remediation.
sents.zh: 修复措施。

sents.en: Validate the final outbound URL at a single choke point immediately before the provider fetch; require routing overrides to match an explicit trusted-host allow-list, checking every field spelling and nested target; apply the same validation to the deprecated proxy route; and disable automatic redirect-following on provider fetches so a redirect cannot escape the destination check.

paragraphs.en: Severity and an important caveat. 91 of the 265 security vulnerabilities are critical or high (29 critical, 62 high), 169 are medium, and 5 are low. Vulnerability class and severity are post-review canonical triage labels derived from model reports. Source-grounded reviews corrected challenged labels, but the resulting severities can still be inflated relative to a deployment-aware human triage: the model cannot see compensating controls (upstream auth, WAF, network policy, rate limits, infrastructure hardening) that mitigate an issue but do not appear in source. We therefore treat the class/severity mix as descriptive of what the pipeline confirms , not as a calibrated risk distribution. Confirmation tiers describe evidential strength and do not substitute for deployment-aware maintainer triage.
paragraphs.zh: 严重程度及一个重要注意事项。265 个安全漏洞中有 91 个为严重或高危（29 个严重，62 个高危），169 个为中危，5 个为低危。 漏洞类别和严重程度是评审后确定的规范分类标签，来源于模型报告。 基于源代码的评审纠正了受到质疑的标签，但所得的严重程度相对于考虑部署情况的人工分类而言仍可能被高估：模型无法看到那些能缓解问题却不出现在源代码中的补偿性控制措施（上游身份验证、WAF、网络策略、速率限制、基础设施加固）。 因此，我们将类别/严重程度的分布视为对流水线所确认内容的描述性刻画，而非经过校准的风险分布。 确认层级描述的是证据强度，不能替代考虑部署情况的维护者分类。

sents.zh: 基于源代码的评审纠正了受到质疑的标签，但所得的严重程度相对于考虑部署情况的人工分类而言仍可能被高估：模型无法看到那些能缓解问题却不出现在源代码中的补偿性控制措施（上游身份验证、WAF、网络策略、速率限制、基础设施加固）。

sents.en: We therefore treat the class/severity mix as descriptive of what the pipeline confirms , not as a calibrated risk distribution.
sents.zh: 因此，我们将类别/严重程度的分布视为对流水线所确认内容的描述性刻画，而非经过校准的风险分布。

sents.en: Confirmation tiers describe evidential strength and do not substitute for deployment-aware maintainer triage.
sents.zh: 确认层级描述的是证据强度，不能替代考虑部署情况的维护者分类。

paragraphs.en: Conduit has real, partly-unpatched vulnerabilities that were non-public at scan time. Publishing repo identity, paths, endpoints, payloads, PoCs, or verbatim context blocks (which embed the endpoint inventory) could expose live users or unpatched attack paths. We therefore withhold them for responsible disclosure, reference the open-source harness, release redacted prompts and aggregate results, and disclose the findings to the maintainers.

paragraphs.en: Experiments, per run. Table 10 gives both runs for all eight conditions and four models (confirmed security identities); the main tables report their mean. Absolute counts shift substantially run-to-run (a model’s A0 yield can change by a third), and the A0-relative deltas vary in magnitude and, for GPT-5.5 on the primary arm, in sign ( + 5 +5 in run 2, − 17 -17 in run 1). paragraphs.en: Two things stand out. (i) A general engineered harness helps all four models: A0 → \to A1 lifts each model above the no-scaffolding floor, most dramatically for GLM. (ii) Targeted context on top is model-specific: A1 → \to codeql-cpg adds further only for Gemma. It reduces yield for Composer, GLM, and GPT-5.5 relative to A1. The same harness ingredient does not affect every model equally; which lever pays off depends on the model.
paragraphs.zh: 有两点值得注意。 （一）通用工程化脚手架对四个模型都有帮助：A0 → \to A1 将每个模型提升到无脚手架基线之上，对 GLM 的提升最为显著。 （二）在此之上的定向上下文则是模型特异的：A1 → \to codeql-cpg 仅对 Gemma 有进一步提升。 相对于 A1，它会降低 Composer、GLM 和 GPT-5.5 的产出。 同一脚手架成分并不会对每个模型产生同等影响；哪个杠杆有效取决于模型本身。
